strategy.primary: cEDH: necessary targeted interaction doubles as crimes, so Marchesa turns each answer into {1} top-two card selection; fast mana and tutors race to Tainted Pact + Thassa's Oracle, Breach + LED/Petal + Brain Freeze, or Aphetto Alchemist + Hawkeye's Bow.
strategy.secondary: Cheap repeatable crime sources (Spatial Binding, Hex Parasite, Spellskite, Tezzeret, Lapis Lazuli Talisman, Talon Gates) keep the selection engine running; Rhystic Study, Remora, Necropotence and Ad Nauseam refill.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Marchesa, Dealer of Death
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text: Whenever you commit a crime, you may pay {1}. If you do, look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other into your graveyard. (Targeting opponents, anything they control, and/or cards in their graveyards is a crime.)

identity.why: Crime trigger: pay {1} for top-two selection.
